2610.10374.title: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
2610.10374.paper_summary: A key challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is moving beyond visual recognition to constraint-aware cross-modal reasoning. This involves combining visual cues with information from other modalities to understand elements' relationships under domain-specific rules. This challenge is acutely evident in industrial design-to-code (D2C), which converts user interface (UI) designs into code and requires MLLMs to connect design images with disorganized layer metadata, infer component and layout implementation requirements, and realize them in code under target-library constraints. However, these capabilities remain insufficiently evaluated in realistic industrial settings. To fill this gap, we present TaoD2C-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to generate UI code that satisfies implementation requirements in industrial applications. The TaoD2C dataset consists of 2,861 production designs from 17 commercial platforms with 97,652 expert annotations across four categories: Component, Group, Alignment, and Position. These annotations distinguish required constraints from permitted implementation choices. TaoD2C-Bench defines three tasks: end-to-end UI code generation, requirement inference, and requirement realization. Evaluating eight MLLMs reveals substantial gaps in generating UI code that satisfies implementation requirements, alongside distinct performance profiles in inference and realization. We further show that MLLMs' visual reconstruction ability does not necessarily imply an ability to generate code that meets these requirements. We release TaoD2C to support research on industrial UI code generation.
2610.10374.paper_summary_zh: 一個多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）的關鍵挑戰是超越視覺識別，進入具約束意識的跨模態推理。<lb/>這涉及將視覺線索與來自其他模態的信息結合，以理解元素在特定領域規則下的關係。<lb/>這一挑戰在工業設計到代碼（D2C）中尤為明顯，該過程將用戶界面（UI）設計轉換為代碼，並要求MLLMs將設計圖像與雜亂的層元數據連接，推斷組件和佈局的實現需求，並在目標庫約束下將其實現為代碼。<lb/>然而，這些能力在現實工業環境中的評估仍然不足。<lb/>為填補這一空白，我們提出了TaoD2C-Bench，這是一個用於評估MLLMs在工業應用中生成滿足實現需求的UI代碼能力的基準。<lb/>TaoD2C數據集由來自17個商業平台的2,861個生產設計組成，並在四個類別中擁有97,652個專家註釋：組件、組、對齊和位置。<lb/>這些註釋區分了所需的約束和允許的實現選擇。<lb/>TaoD2C-Bench定義了三個任務：端到端的UI代碼生成、需求推斷和需求實現。<lb/>對八個MLLMs的評估揭示了在生成滿足實現需求的UI代碼方面存在顯著差距，並且在推斷和實現方面有明顯的性能特徵。<lb/>我們進一步表明，MLLMs的視覺重建能力並不一定意味著能夠生成滿足這些需求的代碼。<lb/>我們發布了TaoD2C，以支持工業UI代碼生成的研究。
